base.scope: Complete V27 source retained locally; archive SHA256 identifies the full V27 source release.

release.photography: 225 credited real photographs and 32 genuine fixed-position panoramas. Story routes can reuse media. All20domains have assigned representative panoramas. The biomedical panorama is a hospital ward, not a surgical theatre or biomedical laboratory.
release.curriculum: Educational subdivisions and route branches, not a qualified manufacturing traveler.
release.demoScope: Full-window photographic and spherical-panorama journeys. No uncaptured surfaces are fabricated; user-imported six views are discrete photos, not a 3D reconstruction. No sensor-calibrated digital twin.
release.narrationScope: Native device speech; two authored core languages; other languages need configured translation and a matching installed voice. Text guidance is always available.
release.videoScope: A separate public HTTPS player removes academy/ChatGPT authentication from file-mode playback. YouTube, publisher, network and browser restrictions still apply.
release.researchScope: Discipline-specific research worksheets; not authored manufacturing instructions.
release.catalogScope: Curated representative topics, not a verified global top-500/top-1000 ranking; includes historical antecedents predating the last century.
release.projectVisualScope: Retained original topic icons plus aviation course diagrams and icons; symbolic teaching art is distinguished from real photographs and engineering drawings.
release.sourceVisibility: The V28 full source archive contains all owner curricula. The SSH uploader generates the existing first-stage public preview. Existing local weights and private documents use a separately verified private repository when requested; provider keys and weights are not bundled.
release.comparisonScope: Each guided course has authored comparisons and representative map points. Repeated institutions are not distinct fabrication sites.
release.aiRoutesScope: Configurable server-side OpenAI-compatible, Claude Messages, Gemini text/image, local Ollama CPU and explicitly loaded browser CPU text. Provider keys and large model weights are not bundled.
release.aiScope: Cloud and local CPU inference adapters and pinned model downloader included. Keys and large model weights are not included. Current route contracts tested with fixtures, not live paid inference.
release.billingScope: Hosted owner/demo and offline editions contain complete source; protected Python HTTPS commerce requires operator configuration. No live payment activated.
release.languageScope: Authored Traditional Chinese and English. 120 locale targets via browser or configured translation service; 79 existing bundled walking HUD dictionaries. Unsupported or unavailable translations retain visible source text.
release.computingScope: 100 focused computing/security curricula plus named quantum, acceleration, energy and resource systems. Original architectural exercises and synthetic local evidence, not deployment or industrial operating manuals.
release.opticsScope: 101 optics and precision-instrument curricula (99 new, asml and a405 extended): 8 authored units per course, each expanded into mechanism, quantitative, verification and failure-diagnosis steps. Original teaching exercises, not vendor recipes or operating procedures.
